# Implementation Plan Template

> Copy this template into `docs/plans/pending/NNN-<slug>.md` when a decision
> is approved. The implementer agent uses this to execute the work.

## Naming

- **File**: `docs/plans/pending/NNN-<short-slug>.md`
- **Sequence**: NNN matches the parent decision number in `docs/decisions/`

## Format

```markdown
# NNN. <Title> -- Implementation Plan

- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Status**: Pending | In Progress | Completed
- **Decision**: `docs/decisions/NNN-<slug>.md`
- **Assigned Agent**: implementer

## Objective

What this plan delivers, referencing the accepted decision.

## Scope

### In Scope

Clear list of what this plan includes.

### Out of Scope

Clear list of what this plan explicitly does NOT include.

## Steps

1. **Step 1** -- description, files touched, acceptance criteria.
2. **Step 2** -- description, files touched, acceptance criteria.
   (expand as needed)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Verification

How the implemented changes will be verified (tests, builds, manual checks).

## Notes

Any context, risks, or open questions for the implementer agent.
```
